---- MODULE LocalLibraryMigration ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

\* ItemKeys lists local items in createdAt order; each key is <<kind, name>>.
\* Calls are sequential browser loads; API outcomes and flag writes may fail.
\* This is the no-loss contract chosen in F1/A, not a claim that the current
\* function conforms: its premature completion/deletion paths are bugs below.
\* shared records only server keys matching an original local item's exact
\* <<kind, name>>; seen is the same projection of one listHistory snapshot.
\* Other server entries (including same-kind/different-name and
\* different-kind/same-name entries) project away: neither counts as a copy.
\* This observational projection preserves every migration decision while
\* avoiding independent state copies for irrelevant server entries.
\* localItems records the original database; the function never removes one row.
\* deleteIssued records deleteDatabase invocation, not asynchronous completion.
\* writes counts attempted uploads, marker writes, and deletion requests.
\* retryItems records first-load failures still absent from the shared store.
\* No fairness is assumed for another browser load or a successful I/O response.
CONSTANTS ItemCount, MaxLoads, FirstKind, SecondKind, FirstName, SecondName

ItemKeys == [i \in 1..ItemCount |->
    <<IF i = 1 THEN FirstKind ELSE SecondKind, FirstName>>]

ServerKeys == {<<FirstKind, FirstName>>, <<SecondKind, FirstName>>,
    <<FirstKind, SecondName>>}
VARIABLES storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems

vars == <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

Items == 1..ItemCount

LocalKeys == {ItemKeys[i] : i \in localItems}

Phases == {"idle", "flag", "open", "metadata", "list", "scan", "read",
    "upload", "mark", "markEmpty", "delete", "return"}

WriteCounts == [upload : 0..(ItemCount * MaxLoads),
    mark : 0..MaxLoads, delete : 0..MaxLoads]

ZeroWrites == [upload |-> 0, mark |-> 0, delete |-> 0]

Current == CHOOSE i \in todo : \A j \in todo : i <= j

Missing == {i \in localItems : ItemKeys[i] \notin shared}

AllShared == Missing = {}

TypeOK ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in SUBSET Items
    /\ shared \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ flag \in BOOLEAN
    /\ deleteIssued \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ loads \in 0..MaxLoads
    /\ todo \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ seen \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ unreadable \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ failed \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ metadataOK \in BOOLEAN
    /\ writes \in WriteCounts
    /\ entryDone \in BOOLEAN
    /\ entryWrites \in WriteCounts
    /\ retryItems \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ (phase \in {"read", "upload"} => todo # {})

DeleteOnlyWhenShared == deleteIssued => AllShared

CompletionRequiresAllShared == flag => AllShared

CompletedLoadsQuiet == entryDone => writes = entryWrites

NoStorageWork == ~storage => writes = ZeroWrites

NoAbsentLibraryCopy ==
    ~oldDatabase => (writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0)

UploadOnlyNewKeys ==
    phase \in {"read", "upload"} => ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen

CopiedAndCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ AllShared
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload > 0

AlreadySharedCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload = 0

UnreadableRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 1
    /\ unreadable \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

FailedUploadRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 1
    /\ failed \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

FailedItemRetried ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ loads = 2
    /\ Current \in retryItems

LaterLoadQuiet ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 2 /\ entryDone
    /\ writes = entryWrites

AbsentLibrarySkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~oldDatabase /\ flag
    /\ writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0

AbsentStorageSkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~storage
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites

EmptyLibraryCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ oldDatabase /\ localItems = {}
    /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ writes.upload = 0

MetadataFailureRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ ~metadataOK /\ Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

Init ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in {1..n : n \in 0..ItemCount}
    /\ (~oldDatabase => localItems = {})
    /\ shared \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ flag = FALSE /\ deleteIssued = FALSE
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 0
    /\ todo = {} /\ seen = {} /\ unreadable = {} /\ failed = {}
    /\ metadataOK = TRUE
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites /\ entryDone = FALSE /\ entryWrites = ZeroWrites
    /\ retryItems = {}

StartLoad ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads < MaxLoads
    /\ loads' = loads + 1 /\ phase' = "flag"
    /\ entryDone' = flag /\ entryWrites' = writes
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK, writes, retryItems>>

ReadFlag ==
    /\ phase = "flag"
    /\ phase' = IF ~storage \/ flag THEN "return" ELSE "open"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {} /\ seen' = {} /\ unreadable' = {} /\ failed' = {}
    /\ metadataOK' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

NoDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ ~oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "markEmpty"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenError ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenThrows ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReadMetadata ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = localItems /\ metadataOK' = TRUE /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MetadataError ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {} /\ metadataOK' = FALSE /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ListShared ==
    /\ phase = "list"
    /\ seen' = shared /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ListError ==
    /\ phase = "list" /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

SkipExisting ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \in seen
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, phase, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

StartRead ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen
    /\ phase' = "read"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReadBytes ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ phase' = "upload"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

BytesUnavailable ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ unreadable' = unreadable \union {Current}
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

UploadSuccess ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ shared' = shared \union {ItemKeys[Current]}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.upload = @ + 1]
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

UploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ failed' = failed \union {Current}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.upload = @ + 1]
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

FinishItems ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {}
    /\ phase' = IF metadataOK /\ unreadable = {} /\ failed = {}
        THEN "mark" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MarkerWritten ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ flag' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = IF phase = "mark" /\ failed = {} THEN "delete" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MarkerError ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1] /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

DeleteDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "delete"
    /\ deleteIssued' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.delete = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReturnFromLoad ==
    /\ phase = "return" /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ retryItems' = IF loads = 1
        THEN (unreadable \union failed) \intersect Missing ELSE retryItems
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites>>

Idle == phase = "idle" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ StartLoad \/ ReadFlag \/ OpenDatabase \/ NoDatabase \/ OpenError \/ OpenThrows
    \/ ReadMetadata \/ MetadataError \/ ListShared \/ ListError
    \/ SkipExisting \/ StartRead \/ ReadBytes \/ BytesUnavailable
    \/ UploadSuccess \/ UploadFailure \/ FinishItems
    \/ MarkerWritten \/ MarkerError \/ DeleteDatabase \/ ReturnFromLoad \/ Idle

DeleteIncomplete ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ ~AllShared
    /\ deleteIssued' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.delete = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

CompleteDespiteUnreadableBytes ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ unreadable \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ phase' = "mark"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

CompleteDespiteUploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ failed \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ phase' = "mark"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

WriteAfterCompletion ==
    /\ phase = "flag" /\ entryDone /\ writes.mark < MaxLoads
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

---- MODULE LocalLibraryMigration ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

\* ItemKeys lists local items in createdAt order; each key is <<kind, name>>.
\* Calls are sequential browser loads; API outcomes and flag writes may fail.
\* This is the no-loss contract chosen in F1/A, revised for the current code
\* after #13; the former completion/deletion mistakes remain bugs below.
\* shared records only server keys matching an original local item's exact
\* <<kind, name>>; seen is the same projection of one listHistory snapshot.
\* Other server entries (including same-kind/different-name and
\* different-kind/same-name entries) project away: neither counts as a copy.
\* This observational projection preserves every migration decision while
\* avoiding independent state copies for irrelevant server entries.
\* localItems records the original database; the function never removes one row.
\* deleteIssued records deleteDatabase invocation, not asynchronous completion.
\* writes counts attempted uploads, marker writes, and deletion requests.
\* retryItems records first-load failures still absent from the shared store.
\* The environment is stable between sequential loads: no concurrent library
\* edits or external flag changes; a failed upload adds no shared key.
\* Request success only supplies a result. ReadMetadata and ReadBytes deliver
\* tx.oncomplete; MetadataAbort and BytesAbort deliver tx.onabort; the Error
\* actions deliver req.onerror (or a synchronous read-setup exception).
\* A request-success callback alone cannot settle either read promise.
\* MissingBytesRequest supplies an absent blob, then BytesUnavailable delivers
\* tx.oncomplete and the missing-blob throw. Late events after rejection stutter.
\* dbOpen observes the opened handle until db.close(), including failure paths.
\* The driver must await promise continuations after delivering these events,
\* stub localStorage and IndexedDB directly, and stand in for listHistory and
\* saveHistoryItem at the API boundary. Open upgrades abort without a database.
\* DeleteDatabase observes invocation even if its request fails or is blocked;
\* the function does not await deletion. Request success, abort, request error,
\* and missing-blob cases must all be exercised by the driver.
\* No fairness is assumed for another browser load or a successful I/O response.
CONSTANTS ItemCount, MaxLoads, FirstKind, SecondKind, FirstName, SecondName

ItemKeys == [i \in 1..ItemCount |->
    <<IF i = 1 THEN FirstKind ELSE SecondKind, FirstName>>]

ServerKeys == {<<FirstKind, FirstName>>, <<SecondKind, FirstName>>,
    <<FirstKind, SecondName>>}
VARIABLES storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems, dbOpen

vars == <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems, dbOpen>>

Items == 1..ItemCount

LocalKeys == {ItemKeys[i] : i \in localItems}

Phases == {"idle", "flag", "open", "metadata", "metadataReady", "list",
    "scan", "read", "readReady", "readMissing", "upload", "mark",
    "markEmpty", "close", "delete", "return"}

WriteCounts == [upload : 0..(ItemCount * MaxLoads),
    mark : 0..MaxLoads, delete : 0..MaxLoads]

ZeroWrites == [upload |-> 0, mark |-> 0, delete |-> 0]

Current == CHOOSE i \in todo : \A j \in todo : i <= j

Missing == {i \in localItems : ItemKeys[i] \notin shared}

AllShared == Missing = {}

TypeOK ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in SUBSET Items
    /\ shared \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ flag \in BOOLEAN
    /\ deleteIssued \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ loads \in 0..MaxLoads
    /\ todo \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ seen \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ unreadable \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ failed \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ metadataOK \in BOOLEAN
    /\ writes \in WriteCounts
    /\ entryDone \in BOOLEAN
    /\ entryWrites \in WriteCounts
    /\ retryItems \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ dbOpen \in BOOLEAN
    /\ (phase \in {"read", "readReady", "readMissing", "upload"} => todo # {})

DeleteOnlyWhenShared == deleteIssued => AllShared

CompletionRequiresAllShared == flag => AllShared

CompletedLoadsQuiet == entryDone => writes = entryWrites

NoStorageWork == ~storage => writes = ZeroWrites

NoAbsentLibraryCopy ==
    ~oldDatabase => (writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0)

UploadOnlyNewKeys ==
    phase \in {"read", "upload"} => ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen

DatabaseClosedAtBoundary ==
    phase \in {"idle", "return", "delete"} => ~dbOpen

FailureLeavesMigrationPending ==
    (~metadataOK \/ unreadable # {} \/ failed # {}) => ~flag

CopiedAndCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ AllShared
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload > 0

AlreadySharedCompleted ==

EmptyLibraryCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ oldDatabase /\ localItems = {}
    /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ writes.upload = 0

MetadataFailureRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ ~metadataOK /\ Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

MetadataTransactionPending == phase = "metadataReady" /\ dbOpen

BytesTransactionPending == phase = "readReady" /\ dbOpen

MissingBlobReturned == phase = "readMissing" /\ dbOpen

Init ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in {1..n : n \in 0..ItemCount}
    /\ (~oldDatabase => localItems = {})
    /\ shared \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ flag = FALSE /\ deleteIssued = FALSE
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 0
    /\ todo = {} /\ seen = {} /\ unreadable = {} /\ failed = {}
    /\ metadataOK = TRUE
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites /\ entryDone = FALSE /\ entryWrites = ZeroWrites
    /\ retryItems = {}
    /\ dbOpen = FALSE

StartLoad ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads < MaxLoads
    /\ loads' = loads + 1 /\ phase' = "flag"
    /\ entryDone' = flag /\ entryWrites' = writes
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK, writes, retryItems, dbOpen>>

ReadFlag ==
    /\ phase = "flag"
    /\ phase' = IF ~storage \/ flag THEN "return" ELSE "open"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,

rules.name: Spec
rules.says: Each browser load follows the modeled migration steps within the checked bounds.

rules.name: DeleteOnlyWhenShared
rules.says: Deletion of the old database is requested only when every original local item is present in the shared library under the same kind and name.

rules.name: CompletionRequiresAllShared
rules.says: The completion flag is never set while any original local item is still absent from the shared library.

rules.name: CompletedLoadsQuiet
rules.says: A load that starts with the completion flag makes no upload, flag-write, or database-deletion attempt.

rules.name: NoStorageWork
rules.says: When reading local storage is unavailable, migration makes no upload, flag-write, or database-deletion attempt.

rules.name: NoAbsentLibraryCopy
rules.says: A browser with no old database uploads no items and requests no database deletion.

rules.name: UploadOnlyNewKeys
rules.says: An item is read for upload only if the shared-library listing lacks its exact kind and name.

rules.name: DatabaseClosedAtBoundary
rules.says: An opened local database is closed before migration returns or requests its deletion.

rules.name: FailureLeavesMigrationPending
rules.says: A metadata-read, byte-read, or upload failure leaves the completion flag unset.

rules.name: TypeOK
rules.says: All stored values, migration phases, item sets, and observed operation counts stay within their declared types and bounds.

rules.name: CopiedAndCompleted
rules.says: Migration can upload local items, mark completion, and request deletion after every local item is shared.

rules.name: AlreadySharedCompleted
rules.says: Migration can finish without uploads when every local item already exists under its kind and name.

rules.name: LaterLoadQuiet
rules.says: A second load after completion can return without making any further writes.

rules.name: AbsentLibrarySkipped
rules.says: A load with no old database can record completion without uploading or deleting anything.

rules.name: AbsentStorageSkipped
rules.says: A load without readable local storage can return without writing anything.

rules.name: EmptyLibraryCompleted
rules.says: An existing empty local database can be marked complete and scheduled for deletion without uploads.

rules.name: UnreadableRetained
rules.says: An item with unreadable bytes can remain local with migration still eligible for a later load.

rules.name: FailedUploadRetained
rules.says: An item whose upload failed can remain local with migration still eligible for a later load.

rules.name: FailedItemRetried
rules.says: A second load can attempt to read an item left uncopied by a first-load read or upload failure.

rules.name: MetadataFailureRetained
rules.says: A metadata-read failure can leave an incomplete local library intact and unmarked for a later load.

rules.name: DeleteIncomplete
rules.says: Migration requests deletion while at least one local item has no shared copy.

rules.name: CompleteDespiteUnreadableBytes
rules.says: Migration proceeds to mark completion after silently skipping an unreadable item that has no shared copy.

rules.name: CompleteDespiteUploadFailure
rules.says: Migration proceeds to mark completion even though an upload failed and the item is still absent from the shared library.

rules.name: WriteAfterCompletion
rules.says: A later load writes the completion flag again despite finding it already set.

rules.name: MetadataTransactionPending
rules.says: A metadata request can succeed while its read still awaits transaction completion.

rules.name: BytesTransactionPending
rules.says: A blob request can return bytes while its read still awaits transaction completion.

rules.name: MissingBlobReturned
rules.says: A blob request can return no bytes before transaction completion causes the migration to fail.

rules.name: CompleteDespiteMetadataFailure
rules.says: Migration treats a failed metadata read as an empty library and proceeds to mark completion while a local item is missing from the shared library.

rules.name: ReturnWithoutClosing
rules.says: Migration returns after a failure without closing its opened local database.

---- MODULE LocalLibraryMigration ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

\* ItemKeys lists local items in createdAt order; each key is <<kind, name>>.
\* Calls are sequential browser loads; API outcomes and flag writes may fail.
\* This is the no-loss contract chosen in F1/A, not a claim that the current
\* function conforms: its premature completion/deletion paths are bugs below.
\* shared records only server keys matching an original local item's exact
\* <<kind, name>>; seen is the same projection of one listHistory snapshot.
\* Other server entries (including same-kind/different-name and
\* different-kind/same-name entries) project away: neither counts as a copy.
\* This observational projection preserves every migration decision while
\* avoiding independent state copies for irrelevant server entries.
\* localItems records the original database; the function never removes one row.
\* deleteIssued records deleteDatabase invocation, not asynchronous completion.
\* writes counts attempted uploads, marker writes, and deletion requests.
\* retryItems records first-load failures still absent from the shared store.
\* No fairness is assumed for another browser load or a successful I/O response.
CONSTANTS ItemCount, MaxLoads, FirstKind, SecondKind, FirstName, SecondName

ItemKeys == [i \in 1..ItemCount |->
    <<IF i = 1 THEN FirstKind ELSE SecondKind, FirstName>>]

ServerKeys == {<<FirstKind, FirstName>>, <<SecondKind, FirstName>>,
    <<FirstKind, SecondName>>}

    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems

---- MODULE LocalLibraryMigration ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

\* ItemKeys lists local items in createdAt order; each key is <<kind, name>>.
\* Calls are sequential browser loads; API outcomes and flag writes may fail.
\* This is the no-loss contract chosen in F1/A, revised for the current code
\* after #13; the former completion/deletion mistakes remain bugs below.
\* shared records only server keys matching an original local item's exact
\* <<kind, name>>; seen is the same projection of one listHistory snapshot.
\* Other server entries (including same-kind/different-name and
\* different-kind/same-name entries) project away: neither counts as a copy.
\* This observational projection preserves every migration decision while
\* avoiding independent state copies for irrelevant server entries.
\* localItems records the original database; the function never removes one row.
\* deleteIssued records deleteDatabase invocation, not asynchronous completion.
\* writes counts attempted uploads, marker writes, and deletion requests.
\* retryItems records first-load failures still absent from the shared store.
\* The environment is stable between sequential loads: no concurrent library
\* edits or external flag changes; a failed upload adds no shared key.
\* Request success only supplies a result. ReadMetadata and ReadBytes deliver
\* tx.oncomplete; MetadataAbort and BytesAbort deliver tx.onabort; the Error
\* actions deliver req.onerror (or a synchronous read-setup exception).
\* A request-success callback alone cannot settle either read promise.
\* MissingBytesRequest supplies an absent blob, then BytesUnavailable delivers
\* tx.oncomplete and the missing-blob throw. Late events after rejection stutter.
\* dbOpen observes the opened handle until db.close(), including failure paths.
\* The driver must await promise continuations after delivering these events,
\* stub localStorage and IndexedDB directly, and stand in for listHistory and
\* saveHistoryItem at the API boundary. Open upgrades abort without a database.
\* DeleteDatabase observes invocation even if its request fails or is blocked;
\* the function does not await deletion. Request success, abort, request error,
\* and missing-blob cases must all be exercised by the driver.
\* No fairness is assumed for another browser load or a successful I/O response.
CONSTANTS ItemCount, MaxLoads, FirstKind, SecondKind, FirstName, SecondName

ItemKeys == [i \in 1..ItemCount |->
    <<IF i = 1 THEN FirstKind ELSE SecondKind, FirstName>>]

ServerKeys == {<<FirstKind, FirstName>>, <<SecondKind, FirstName>>,
    <<FirstKind, SecondName>>}
VARIABLES storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems, dbOpen

    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems, dbOpen>>

Items == 1..ItemCount

LocalKeys == {ItemKeys[i] : i \in localItems}

Phases == {"idle", "flag", "open", "metadata", "metadataReady", "list",
    "scan", "read", "readReady", "readMissing", "upload", "mark",
    "markEmpty", "close", "delete", "return"}

WriteCounts == [upload : 0..(ItemCount * MaxLoads),
    mark : 0..MaxLoads, delete : 0..MaxLoads]

ZeroWrites == [upload |-> 0, mark |-> 0, delete |-> 0]

Current == CHOOSE i \in todo : \A j \in todo : i <= j

Missing == {i \in localItems : ItemKeys[i] \notin shared}

AllShared == Missing = {}

TypeOK ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in SUBSET Items
    /\ shared \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ flag \in BOOLEAN
    /\ deleteIssued \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ loads \in 0..MaxLoads
    /\ todo \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ seen \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ unreadable \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ failed \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ metadataOK \in BOOLEAN
    /\ writes \in WriteCounts
    /\ entryDone \in BOOLEAN
    /\ entryWrites \in WriteCounts
    /\ retryItems \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ dbOpen \in BOOLEAN

DeleteOnlyWhenShared == deleteIssued => AllShared

CompletionRequiresAllShared == flag => AllShared

CompletedLoadsQuiet == entryDone => writes = entryWrites

NoStorageWork == ~storage => writes = ZeroWrites

NoAbsentLibraryCopy ==
    ~oldDatabase => (writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0)

UploadOnlyNewKeys ==
    phase \in {"read", "upload"} => ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen

DatabaseClosedAtBoundary ==
    phase \in {"idle", "return", "delete"} => ~dbOpen

FailureLeavesMigrationPending ==
    (~metadataOK \/ unreadable # {} \/ failed # {}) => ~flag

CopiedAndCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ AllShared
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload > 0

AlreadySharedCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload = 0

UnreadableRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 1
    /\ unreadable \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

FailedUploadRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 1
    /\ failed \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

FailedItemRetried ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ loads = 2
    /\ Current \in retryItems

LaterLoadQuiet ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 2 /\ entryDone
    /\ writes = entryWrites

AbsentLibrarySkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~oldDatabase /\ flag
    /\ writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0

AbsentStorageSkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~storage
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites

EmptyLibraryCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ oldDatabase /\ localItems = {}
    /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ writes.upload = 0

MetadataFailureRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ ~metadataOK /\ Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

MetadataTransactionPending == phase = "metadataReady" /\ dbOpen

BytesTransactionPending == phase = "readReady" /\ dbOpen

MissingBlobReturned == phase = "readMissing" /\ dbOpen

Init ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in {1..n : n \in 0..ItemCount}
    /\ (~oldDatabase => localItems = {})
    /\ shared \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ flag = FALSE /\ deleteIssued = FALSE
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 0
    /\ todo = {} /\ seen = {} /\ unreadable = {} /\ failed = {}
    /\ metadataOK = TRUE
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites /\ entryDone = FALSE /\ entryWrites = ZeroWrites
    /\ retryItems = {}
    /\ dbOpen = FALSE

    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads < MaxLoads
    /\ loads' = loads + 1 /\ phase' = "flag"
    /\ entryDone' = flag /\ entryWrites' = writes
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK, writes, retryItems, dbOpen>>

    /\ phase' = IF ~storage \/ flag THEN "return" ELSE "open"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems, dbOpen>>

OpenDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {}
    /\ seen' = {}
    /\ unreadable' = {}
    /\ failed' = {}
    /\ metadataOK' = TRUE
    /\ dbOpen' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
        loads, writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

NoDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ ~oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "markEmpty"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems, dbOpen>>

OpenError ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "return"

    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems, dbOpen>>

ReadMetadata ==
    /\ phase = "metadataReady"
    /\ todo' = localItems
    /\ metadataOK' = TRUE
    /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
        loads, seen, unreadable, failed, writes, entryDone,
        entryWrites, retryItems, dbOpen>>

MetadataError ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {}
    /\ metadataOK' = FALSE
    /\ phase' = "close"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
        loads, seen, unreadable, failed, writes, entryDone,
        entryWrites, retryItems, dbOpen>>

ListShared ==
    /\ phase = "list"
    /\ seen' = shared /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,

SkipExisting ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \in seen
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, phase, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,

StartRead ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen
    /\ phase' = "read"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,

baseline.model:
---- MODULE LocalLibraryMigration ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

\* ItemKeys lists local items in createdAt order; each key is <<kind, name>>.
\* Calls are sequential browser loads; API outcomes and flag writes may fail.
\* This is the no-loss contract chosen in F1/A, not a claim that the current
\* function conforms: its premature completion/deletion paths are bugs below.
\* shared records only server keys matching an original local item's exact
\* <<kind, name>>; seen is the same projection of one listHistory snapshot.
\* Other server entries (including same-kind/different-name and
\* different-kind/same-name entries) project away: neither counts as a copy.
\* This observational projection preserves every migration decision while
\* avoiding independent state copies for irrelevant server entries.
\* localItems records the original database; the function never removes one row.
\* deleteIssued records deleteDatabase invocation, not asynchronous completion.
\* writes counts attempted uploads, marker writes, and deletion requests.
\* retryItems records first-load failures still absent from the shared store.
\* No fairness is assumed for another browser load or a successful I/O response.
CONSTANTS ItemCount, MaxLoads, FirstKind, SecondKind, FirstName, SecondName

ItemKeys == [i \in 1..ItemCount |->
    <<IF i = 1 THEN FirstKind ELSE SecondKind, FirstName>>]

ServerKeys == {<<FirstKind, FirstName>>, <<SecondKind, FirstName>>,
    <<FirstKind, SecondName>>}
VARIABLES storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems

vars == <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

Items == 1..ItemCount

LocalKeys == {ItemKeys[i] : i \in localItems}

Phases == {"idle", "flag", "open", "metadata", "list", "scan", "read",
    "upload", "mark", "markEmpty", "delete", "return"}

WriteCounts == [upload : 0..(ItemCount * MaxLoads),
    mark : 0..MaxLoads, delete : 0..MaxLoads]

ZeroWrites == [upload |-> 0, mark |-> 0, delete |-> 0]

Current == CHOOSE i \in todo : \A j \in todo : i <= j

Missing == {i \in localItems : ItemKeys[i] \notin shared}

AllShared == Missing = {}

TypeOK ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in SUBSET Items
    /\ shared \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ flag \in BOOLEAN
    /\ deleteIssued \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ loads \in 0..MaxLoads
    /\ todo \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ seen \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ unreadable \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ failed \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ metadataOK \in BOOLEAN
    /\ writes \in WriteCounts
    /\ entryDone \in BOOLEAN
    /\ entryWrites \in WriteCounts
    /\ retryItems \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ (phase \in {"read", "upload"} => todo # {})

DeleteOnlyWhenShared == deleteIssued => AllShared

CompletionRequiresAllShared == flag => AllShared

CompletedLoadsQuiet == entryDone => writes = entryWrites

NoStorageWork == ~storage => writes = ZeroWrites

NoAbsentLibraryCopy ==
    ~oldDatabase => (writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0)

UploadOnlyNewKeys ==
    phase \in {"read", "upload"} => ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen

CopiedAndCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ AllShared
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload > 0

AlreadySharedCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload = 0

UnreadableRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 1
    /\ unreadable \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

FailedUploadRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 1
    /\ failed \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

FailedItemRetried ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ loads = 2
    /\ Current \in retryItems

LaterLoadQuiet ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 2 /\ entryDone
    /\ writes = entryWrites

AbsentLibrarySkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~oldDatabase /\ flag
    /\ writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0

AbsentStorageSkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~storage
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites

EmptyLibraryCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ oldDatabase /\ localItems = {}
    /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ writes.upload = 0

MetadataFailureRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ ~metadataOK /\ Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

Init ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in {1..n : n \in 0..ItemCount}
    /\ (~oldDatabase => localItems = {})
    /\ shared \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ flag = FALSE /\ deleteIssued = FALSE
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 0
    /\ todo = {} /\ seen = {} /\ unreadable = {} /\ failed = {}
    /\ metadataOK = TRUE
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites /\ entryDone = FALSE /\ entryWrites = ZeroWrites
    /\ retryItems = {}

StartLoad ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads < MaxLoads
    /\ loads' = loads + 1 /\ phase' = "flag"
    /\ entryDone' = flag /\ entryWrites' = writes
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK, writes, retryItems>>

ReadFlag ==
    /\ phase = "flag"
    /\ phase' = IF ~storage \/ flag THEN "return" ELSE "open"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {} /\ seen' = {} /\ unreadable' = {} /\ failed' = {}
    /\ metadataOK' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

NoDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ ~oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "markEmpty"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenError ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenThrows ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReadMetadata ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = localItems /\ metadataOK' = TRUE /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MetadataError ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {} /\ metadataOK' = FALSE /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ListShared ==
    /\ phase = "list"
    /\ seen' = shared /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ListError ==
    /\ phase = "list" /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

SkipExisting ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \in seen
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, phase, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

StartRead ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen
    /\ phase' = "read"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReadBytes ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ phase' = "upload"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

BytesUnavailable ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ unreadable' = unreadable \union {Current}
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

UploadSuccess ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ shared' = shared \union {ItemKeys[Current]}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.upload = @ + 1]
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

UploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ failed' = failed \union {Current}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.upload = @ + 1]
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

FinishItems ==

---- MODULE LocalLibraryMigration ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

\* ItemKeys lists local items in createdAt order; each key is <<kind, name>>.
\* Calls are sequential browser loads; API outcomes and flag writes may fail.
\* This is the no-loss contract chosen in F1/A, revised for the current code
\* after #13; the former completion/deletion mistakes remain bugs below.
\* shared records only server keys matching an original local item's exact
\* <<kind, name>>; seen is the same projection of one listHistory snapshot.
\* Other server entries (including same-kind/different-name and
\* different-kind/same-name entries) project away: neither counts as a copy.
\* This observational projection preserves every migration decision while
\* avoiding independent state copies for irrelevant server entries.
\* localItems records the original database; the function never removes one row.
\* deleteIssued records deleteDatabase invocation, not asynchronous completion.
\* writes counts attempted uploads, marker writes, and deletion requests.
\* retryItems records first-load failures still absent from the shared store.
\* The environment is stable between sequential loads: no concurrent library
\* edits or external flag changes; a failed upload adds no shared key.
\* Request success only supplies a result. ReadMetadata and ReadBytes deliver
\* tx.oncomplete; MetadataAbort and BytesAbort deliver tx.onabort; the Error
\* actions deliver req.onerror (or a synchronous read-setup exception).
\* A request-success callback alone cannot settle either read promise.
\* MissingBytesRequest supplies an absent blob, then BytesUnavailable delivers
\* tx.oncomplete and the missing-blob throw. Late events after rejection stutter.
\* dbOpen observes the opened handle until db.close(), including failure paths.
\* The driver must await promise continuations after delivering these events,
\* stub localStorage and IndexedDB directly, and stand in for listHistory and
\* saveHistoryItem at the API boundary. Open upgrades abort without a database.
\* DeleteDatabase observes invocation even if its request fails or is blocked;
\* the function does not await deletion. Request success, abort, request error,
\* and missing-blob cases must all be exercised by the driver.
\* No fairness is assumed for another browser load or a successful I/O response.
CONSTANTS ItemCount, MaxLoads, FirstKind, SecondKind, FirstName, SecondName

ItemKeys == [i \in 1..ItemCount |->
    <<IF i = 1 THEN FirstKind ELSE SecondKind, FirstName>>]

ServerKeys == {<<FirstKind, FirstName>>, <<SecondKind, FirstName>>,
    <<FirstKind, SecondName>>}
VARIABLES storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems, dbOpen

    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems, dbOpen>>

Items == 1..ItemCount

LocalKeys == {ItemKeys[i] : i \in localItems}

Phases == {"idle", "flag", "open", "metadata", "metadataReady", "list",
    "scan", "read", "readReady", "readMissing", "upload", "mark",
    "markEmpty", "close", "delete", "return"}

WriteCounts == [upload : 0..(ItemCount * MaxLoads),
    mark : 0..MaxLoads, delete : 0..MaxLoads]

ZeroWrites == [upload |-> 0, mark |-> 0, delete |-> 0]

Current == CHOOSE i \in todo : \A j \in todo : i <= j

Missing == {i \in localItems : ItemKeys[i] \notin shared}

    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN

    /\ localItems \in SUBSET Items

    /\ flag \in BOOLEAN
    /\ deleteIssued \in BOOLEAN

    ~oldDatabase => (writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0)

    phase \in {"read", "upload"} => ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen
